entries.title: Esther 7:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Esther, entertaining the king and Haman, makes suit for her own life, and her people's. 5 She accuses Haman. 7 The king in his anger, understanding of the gallows which Haman had made for Mordecai, causes him to be hanged thereon.

banquet. Heb. drink. 3:15; 5:8

entries.title: Esther 7:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: let my life. 7; 1Ki 20:31; 2Ki 1:13; Job 2:4; Jer 38:26 my people. 4:8; Ps 122:6-9

entries.title: Esther 7:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: we are sold. 3:9; 4:7,8; De 28:68; 1Sa 22:23 to be destroyed, etc. Heb. that they should destroy, andkill, and cause to perish. 3:13; 8:11; Ps 44:22,23 But if we. Ge 37:26-28; De 28:68; Jos 9:23; Ne 5:5; Joe 3:6; Am 2:6 the enemy. 6; 3:9

entries.title: Esther 7:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Who is he. Ge 27:33; Job 9:24 that durst, etc. Heb. whose heart hath filled him. Ac 5:3

entries.title: Esther 7:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: The adversary. Heb. The man adversary. this wicked. 1Sa 24:13; Ps 27:2; 139:19-22; Pr 24:24,25; Ec 5:8; 1Co 5:13 2Th 2:8 was afraid. Ne 6:16; Job 15:21,22; 18:5-12; Ps 73:5-9,17-20; Pr 16:14 Isa 21:4; Da 5:5,6 before. or, at the presence of.

entries.title: Esther 7:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: in his wrath. 1:12 Haman. Pr 14:19; Isa 60:14; Re 3:9 for he saw. 1Sa 20:7,9; 25:17; Ps 112:10; Pr 19:12; Da 3:19

entries.title: Esther 7:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
the bed. 1:6; Isa 49:23 before me. Heb. with me. they covered Haman's.When a criminal was condemned by a Roman judge, he was delivered to the serjeant with these words: {I, lictor, caput obnubito arbori infelici suspendito,} "Go, sergeant, cover his head, and hang him on the accursed tree."

6:12; Job 9:24; Isa 22:17

entries.title: Esther 7:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Harbonah. 1:10 Harbona. one of the chamberlains. 6:14; 2Ki 9:32 Behold. 5:14; Job 27:20-23; Ps 7:15,16; 35:8; 141:10; Pr 11:5,6 gallows. Heb. tree. who had spoken. 2:21-23; 6:2 Hang him thereon. 9:25; 1Sa 17:51; Ps 7:15,16; 9:15,16; 35:8; 37:35,36; 73:19 Pr 11:5,6; Da 6:7,24

entries.title: Esther 7:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Then was the king's. Jud 15:7; Eze 5:13; Zec 6:8
